title: Rugford's Mountain Rest
wikitext:
[[File:Rugford's Mountain Rest.jpg|thumb|300px|Rugford's Mountain Rest]]
'''Rugford's Mountain Rest''' is a famous and beloved inn that is nestled in the southeastern mountains of [[Dun Morogh]], uphill behind [[Ironband's Compound]]. Established many years ago by [[Durmir Rugford]], it formerly offered respite and rest for the mountaineers of Ironforge, and has now been overrun by sinister Dark Iron marauders sowing chaos in the dwarven kingdom.<ref>[https://web.archive.org/web/20260514170802/https://turtlecraft.gg/new-locations-and-maps New Zones & World Edits]. Archived from [https://turtlecraft.gg/new-locations-and-maps the original] on 2026-05-14. Retrieved on 2026-29-08.</ref>
